fusions.name: Common Thread
fusions.desc: Casts woven force over a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and leaving them [Hindered] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Come Unstitched
fusions.desc: Pulls apart every affliction on the target, dealing 18 damage plus 1.5 times the damage they had left to deal, and leaves it [Exposed] for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Folded Light
fusions.desc: Veils you and every ally near you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Embroidered Sleeves
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner, and you have 8% arcane resistance.
